fillInstructions.description: Removing the bubble rims and highlights reveals uninterrupted underlying panel content at each bubble location: cyan/teal water gradients in upper areas, parts of the pineapple/sea region on the right, and pale sandy seafloor with subtle speckling in lower areas. No new object appears; each bubble hole should be filled by direct continuation of whatever scene pixels surround that bubble segment.
continueEdges: Continue local underwater gradients smoothly through each removed ring segment in the upper-left and right clusters
Preserve any nearby contour lines (pineapple edges, seabed horizon transitions, or soft background boundaries) straight through former bubble positions
Maintain sandy texture continuity in lower bubbles, including fine grain/speckle and soft shading variation
Blend edge anti-aliasing softly so no circular seam remains where bubble outlines were
